Toffee bars are an easy, crowd-pleasing dessert that’s perfect for sharing. If you love desserts with shortbread, think of these as a simpler cousin to millionaire’s shortbread, with their signature layers of shortbread, caramel, and chocolate. As soon as the brown sugar shortbread crust comes out of the oven, semisweet chocolate chips are scattered over the top and left to melt into a smooth layer, then finished with toasted pecans, crunchy toffee bits, and flaky sea salt.
